newsitem.title: UK: Low & Bonar bounces after full-year results.
newsitem.headline: Low & Bonar bounces after full-year results.

text.p: Shares in Low & Bonar Plc rose in early trade on Monday after the company posted little changed pre-tax profits for the year to November 11 but said margins had improved and efficiency improvements remained on the agenda. Bouncing from the two-year lows set earlier this month, shares in the paper and packaging group were up 15-1/2p at 413-1/2 by 0819 GMT.
"There was nothing spectacular about the results," one market-maker said, "They've been a very poor performer. It's just a little bit of relief with the figures."
The stock tumbled in October 1996, when the firm issued a profits warning after weaker than expected trading conditions in North America.
